title: Accessible Minivan Arrives
excerpt: Our new accessible minivan rolled in January 12—smaller-group transport for day program and community engagement.
content:
On January 12, 2026, Autism Sanctuary welcomed our new accessible minivan. It’s the first of the vehicles supported through CA-MPO and FTA Section 5310 funding to reach the farm—perfect for smaller groups, community engagement outings, and flexible day-to-day transport.

Having the right vehicle for the right outing means fewer barriers and more time doing what matters: trails, gardens, animals, and being part of the wider community.

Read how the funding came together in MPO Approves Paratransit Vehicle Funding, and see the bus arrival that followed in February.
